name: morning-brief
title_zh: 醒来先看昨晚邮件和今天日程的一页晨报
tagline_zh: 早上不想在三个 App 之间来回翻：它把过夜邮件、今天的日程和标了紧急的条目压成一页，按时间排好。
tagline_en: Stop hopping between three apps at 7am. It compresses overnight email, today's calendar and flagged urgent items.
desc_en: Compile a morning briefing across the user's connected tools — overnight email, today's calendar, urgent items. Use when asked for a brief, digest, summary of the day, or when running as a scheduled morning task.
why_zh: 先跨工具取数再排序，不是把每个源的原文堆在一起；紧急项单独拎出来，其余按时间轴铺开。
why_en: It pulls across tools and then ranks, instead of dumping raw feeds; urgent items get lifted out, the rest laid on a timeline.
limit_zh: 只汇总你已经接上的工具，没连的邮箱和日历它一个字也编不出来；它只读不写，不会替你回邮件或改日程，紧急与否靠源里的标记。
limit_en: Only summarizes tools you've already connected; unconnected mail or calendars yield nothing. Read-only: it won't reply or reschedule, and urgency.
title_en: One-page morning brief: overnight email + today's calendar
